empty.purpose: Says All music holds no tracks.
empty.where: All music screen, when the scan found no tracks and nothing is searched.

noMatch.where: All music screen, when a search has no matching tracks.

search.purpose: Label and placeholder of the search box.
search.where: All music screen, search input at the top.

showing.purpose: Says the list is cut off: how many tracks are shown of how many match.
showing.where: All music screen, above the table, when more tracks match than are listed.

columns.title.purpose: Column heading for a track's title.

columns.artist.purpose: Column heading for a track's artist.

columns.file.purpose: Column heading for a track's file path.

columns.library.purpose: Column heading for the Library status and its Add button.
columns.library.where: All music table header, last column.

add.purpose: Button that adds a track to the Library.
add.where: All music table, Library column, on a track not yet in the Library.

inLibrary.purpose: Says a track is already in the Library.
inLibrary.where: All music table, Library column, on a track already in it.
